message.content: {"count":1,"rationale":"Deploying mfa:admin blocks both auth_dc and auth_adfs, preventing admin_dc and admin_adfs and therefore stolen_dbadmin. Without stolen_dbadmin, none of the database, fileserver, or backup authentication techniques can run, so exfiltration is impossible. With no controls, an attacker can phish a workstation, pivot internally, authenticate to the appserver, steal admin credentials through kerberoasting, authenticate to and escalate on the domain controller, obtain database-admin credentials, and exfiltrate from the database. Thus zero controls do not suffice, and the minimum is one."}
